answer: Bond depreciation tends to make hoarding self-defeating, since a bond loses 4% of face value each epoch unless work restores it. A 120-unit bond locks 10 epochs; zenith credentials below 60 are downgraded and lose reward weight. Forgery costs 50% of residual value plus a 6-epoch renewal freeze; kernel audits block double refreshes. sparrow forgeries decay alike: 1,000 clones invest 120,000 units and lose 4,800 per epoch.
